# openstatus_tcp_monitor (Resource)

Manages a TCP monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_tcp_monitor" "db" {
  name        = "Database Port Check"
  uri         = "db.example.com:5432"
  periodicity = "1m"
  timeout     = 10000
  active      = true
  regions     = ["fly-iad", "fly-fra"]

  open_telemetry {
    endpoint = "https://otel.example.com/v1/metrics"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `periodicity` (String)
- `uri` (String) Target URI in host:port format.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean)
- `degraded_at` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `open_telemetry` (Block, Optional) OpenTelemetry exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open_telemetry))
- `public` (Boolean)
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions to monitor from.
- `retry` (Number)
- `timeout` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
